name: runtime-assembly-sidecar-resolver
title: Application pack and user-environment sidecar resolver
description: Assemble the application-only Windows pack, create a per-user isolated Python environment from a supported base, and run the sidecar without packaging CPython, PyTorch, CUDA, or model weights.
creator: xingran
notes: Scope revised: the desktop uses a supported user-installed Python only as a base, creates %LOCALAPPDATA%/FigureSmith/python-env, installs bootstrap packages there without modifying the base, and keeps model diagnostics separate from editor readiness.
